# Pages

A page's record (name, address, status, place, access, layout, head, article listing) and its content as a whole. To add or delete a page as a person does, use page.add and page.remove; page.create, page.init, page.delete and page.drop are what a stored log and an import write.

## page.init

Give a page that has no content its content, whole: its tree, timelines, states and head. A page made with page.add has its content already; this is for a page record made with page.create, or one whose content page.drop took. Refused when the page has content (`duplicate_key`); the validator checks the tree.

## page.drop

Take a page's content away (its tree, timelines, states and head), leaving its record. To delete a page use page.remove, its record and content in one step. Refused when the page has no content (`unknown_page`).

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The page's id, as the site read lists its pages. |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"87c82653-80cd-4b17-ae54-aca941cbf8a2"}
```

## page.setLayout

Frame a page with one of the site's layouts, with that layout's variant, props and overrides for this page alone; null takes its layout off. A layout is the component of role `layout` that draws the header, the footer and the frame round the page. Refused for a page the site does not have (`unknown_page`); the validator checks the layout and its role.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The page's id, as the site read lists its pages. |

## page.create

Create a page's record alone (its address, status, parent, place, type and name), with no tree: page.init gives it one. To add a page as a person does, use page.add, which makes the record and a first tree in one step and draws the id. Refused with `duplicate_key` (the id is taken), `page.slug` (a sibling holds the address in some language, or the slug is reserved at the top level), `page.parent` (the parent is no page, or makes a cycle), `page.folder` (a folder that is a draft or has an access rule) and `route.taken` (an item or another page answers the path).

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The new page's id: a fresh UUID you draw, no page or tree of the site holds. |
| `record` | object | yes | The page record: slug, slugs (language → slug), status (draft or published), parentId (null: the top level), position, pageType (static, blog-index, article, dynamic, folder), title (language → name), and any other field the site keeps on a page. |
| `record` › `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) |  |  |
| `record` › `slugs` | Record<string, string (min 1, max 100)> \| null |  |  |
| `record` › `status` | "draft" \| "published" |  |  |
| `record` › `parentId` | uuid \| null |  |  |
| `record` › `position` | integer ≥0 |  |  |
| `record` › `accessPasswordHash` | string \| null |  |  |
| `record` › `requireAuth` | boolean |  |  |
| `record` › `requiredRoles` | string (min 1, max 64)[] (≤50) |  |  |
| `record` › `pageType` | string (max 40) |  |  |
| `record` › `itemRoute` | "nested" \| "root" |  |  |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"c41d7e2a-9b3f-4a58-8e16-2f0b7d9a3c54","record":{"slug":"studio","status":"published","parentId":null,"position":30,"pageType":"static","title":{"it":"Lo studio"}}}
```

## page.delete

Delete a page's record alone; its tree goes with page.drop in the same batch. To delete a page as a person does, use page.remove (the record and the tree in one step). Refused with `page.has_children` (pages sit under it; detail.pages), `page.home` (the home page), `page.inMenu` (a menu links it; detail.menus), `page.linked` (something links to it; detail.links) and `unknown_page`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"cdf66aa4-4320-4c8d-a7ed-8c10c0b64989"}
```

## page.setSlug

Set a page's address segment in the main language (`slug`) and in other languages (`slugs`: language → slug; null removes one, so that language answers `slug`). A slug is lower-case words joined by `-`, or a dynamic segment `[name]`. Refused with `page.slug` (a sibling holds it in some language, it is reserved at the top level, or a language in `slugs` is the main one or none of the site's) and `route.taken` (an item or another page answers the new path).

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "address", "slug".

|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) |  | The segment in the main language: lower-case words joined by `-` (`lavori`), or `[name]` for a dynamic segment. |
| `slugs` | Record<string, string (min 1, max 100) \| null> |  | The segment in other languages: language → slug; null removes that language's. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"pageId":"3ba4b719-a6fe-4c56-a8a1-ef60cc3586c2","slug":"progetti"}
```


## page.setStatus

Mark a page `published` (part of what the next publish puts live) or `draft` (kept off the live site). Publishing the site is `publication.publish`; this only says whether the page is part of it. Refused with `page.folder` (a folder is never a draft) and `unknown_page`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

|---|---|---|---|

| `status` | "draft" \| "published" | yes |  |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"935b8383-32ab-485b-ad6f-989ed59ceb9b","status":"draft"}
```

## page.move

Put a page under another page (`parentId`; null: the top level), at `position` among its siblings; its address follows its parent's path. Refused with `page.parent` (the parent is no page of the site, or is the page itself or under it), `page.slug` (a new sibling holds its slug) and `route.taken`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| `parentId` | uuid \| null | yes | The page to put it under; null: the top level. |
| `position` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place among its new siblings (lower first); absent: it keeps its number. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"pageId":"51c8bffb-cbdb-4746-afad-319dbc96382d","parentId":"3ba4b719-a6fe-4c56-a8a1-ef60cc3586c2","position":5}
```

## page.setAccess

Set who opens a page: members only (`requireAuth`), the member roles that open it (`requiredRoles`: any one of them; none: every signed-in member) and its password. Send the password in plain words: the server puts its hash in its place before the op runs, so no log entry or read holds it; null removes it, absent keeps it. Refused with `page.access` (roles without requireAuth), `memberRole.unknown` (a role the site does not have) and `page.folder` (a folder takes no access rule).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "private", "password".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |
| `requireAuth` | boolean | yes | True: only signed-in members open it. |
| `requiredRoles` | string (max 40)[] (≤50) |  | Member role keys, any one of which opens it (needs requireAuth); empty: every member. |
| `password` | string \| null |  | The page's password, sent in plain words: the server stores its hash in its place before the op runs (the op itself reads that hash). Null removes it; absent keeps it. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"pageId":"5dc75cd8-babd-4fc7-a6cd-bd8a9fd77068","requireAuth":true,"requiredRoles":["clienti"]}
```
```json
{"pageId":"5dc75cd8-babd-4fc7-a6cd-bd8a9fd77068","requireAuth":false,"requiredRoles":[],"password":null}
```

## page.setItemRoute

Set where the items of a dynamic page (one page per item of a collection) answer: under the page's path or at the top of the site. `nested` answers at /<page path>/<item slug> (the default); `root` at /<item slug>, sharing the top level with the pages, and each item's nested path then answers 301 to it. Refused with `page.not_dynamic` (the page is no dynamic page) and `route.taken`, listing every clash, when a page, another item or a reserved path holds an item's path.

- **op**; class `structure` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |
| `route` | "nested" \| "root" | yes |  |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"3ba4b719-a6fe-4c56-a8a1-ef60cc3586c2","route":"root"}
```

## page.setArticle

Set what a list of pages shows of a page and who wrote it: its excerpt per language, its listing picture, its author's name and, when the author is a person of the site, their user id. An article's card on its blog's list reads these. A field given is set, null clears it, a field left out is kept. Refused with `page.image` (no such picture in the media library, or a file that is no picture) and `page.locale` (an excerpt language the site does not have).

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "blog", "article", "post".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |
| `excerpt` | Record<string, string (min 1, max 1000) \| null> |  | The excerpt a list of pages shows, by language: language → text (null removes that language's). Languages left out are kept. |
| `featuredImageId` | uuid \| null |  | The picture a list of pages shows for it: a media id of an image or an SVG of the media library; null removes it. |
| `authorName` | string (min 1, max 120) \| null |  | The name a list and the page show as its author; null removes it. |
| `authorUserId` | string (min 1, max 36) \| null |  | When the author is a person of the site, their user id; null removes it. |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"51c8bffb-cbdb-4746-afad-319dbc96382d","excerpt":{"it":"Restauro di un appartamento storico affacciato su Via Giulia."},"featuredImageId":"86ec6080-05c6-423e-a6b3-d921c8449495","authorName":"Archiplan"}
```

## page.restore

## page.duplicate

Copy a page (`from`: its record and its tree) as a new page `pageId` with its own address (`slug`) and name (`title`), beside it. The copy is shown unless `status` says draft (it goes live at the next publish like any change); its other-language slugs and the home flag are not copied, and its head title takes the new name. Refused with `duplicate_key` (the new id is taken), `unknown_page` (no source page), `page.slug` (a sibling holds the slug) and `route.taken`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "blog", "article", "post".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The new page's id: a fresh UUID you draw, no page or tree of the site holds. |
| `from` | uuid | yes | The page to copy. |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes | The copy's address segment: lower-case words joined by `-`. |
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes | The copy's name, in the site's main language. |
| `position` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place among its siblings; absent: the source's. |
| `status` | "draft" \| "published" |  | Absent: published (shown). |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"7e3a9c15-2d4b-4f86-a0c7-5b1e8d2f6a93","from":"51c8bffb-cbdb-4746-afad-319dbc96382d","slug":"via-giulia-secondo-lotto","title":"Via Giulia, secondo lotto"}
```

## page.revert

Bring a page back as an earlier version held it: its record and its tree, whole, in one step that undo takes back. Read `page-restore/<version>?page=<pageId>` (the `versions` read names the versions, `version-pages/<version>` the pages each holds): its `ops` bring the page back as one step, so send them as they are. Who opens the page (members only, roles, password) stays as the draft has it, and the live site changes only at the next publish. The page must be in the draft (a deleted page comes back with page.create and page.init). Refused with `page.revertMissing` (detail: missing, names) when the site no longer has the layout, a component, the parent page or the collection the version named, and `unknown_page`.

```json
{"pageId":"e71e23d0-36c6-40c0-afa1-261ab27cf2b4","record":{"slug":"contatti","status":"published","parentId":null,"position":50,"pageType":"static","title":{"it":"Contatti"},"layout":{"key":"layout.default"}},"content":{"tree":{"format":"splash.tree","v":4,"root":"ct0body0","nodes":{"ct0body0":{"kind":"frame","as":"body","children":["ct0sect0"]},"ct0sect0":{"kind":"frame","as":"section","children":["ct0head0"]},"ct0head0":{"kind":"text","as":"h1","text":"Contatti"}}},"timelines":{},"states":{},"head":{"title":"Contatti","lang":"it"}}}
```

## page.add

Add a page as a person does: its record and a first tree a visitor can see (its name as the heading of a first section), in one step; the core draws its id and answers `{ pageId }`. Give its name, its address, where it goes and the layout that frames it. It is shown at once (the next publish puts it live) unless `status` is `draft`, and a section added later goes beside the first one. Use it rather than page.create and page.init, which a stored log and an import write. Refused with `unknown_page` (no such parent), `unknown_component` (no layout by that key), `page.slug` (a sibling holds the address, or it is reserved) and `route.taken`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes | The page's name in the site's main language: what lists and menus show, and the heading of its first section. |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes | Its address segment: lower-case words joined by `-` (`studio`), or `[name]` for a dynamic segment. |
| `slugs` | Record<string, string (min 1, max 100)> |  | Its address segment in other languages: language → slug; a language without one answers `slug`. |
| `parentId` | uuid \| null |  | The page to put it under; absent or null: the top level. |
| `position` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place among its siblings (lower first); absent: after the last. |
| `layout` | string \| null |  | The key of a layout of the site that frames it (its header and footer); absent: the home page's layout; null: none. |
| `status` | "draft" \| "published" |  | `draft`: hidden from visitors until shown (page.setStatus); absent: published (shown at the next publish). |
| `declares` | false |  | Leave it out: only a step stored before pages said which node holds their sections carries false. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"title":"Lo studio","slug":"studio"}
```
```json
{"title":"Via Margutta","slug":"via-margutta","parentId":"3ba4b719-a6fe-4c56-a8a1-ef60cc3586c2","layout":"layout.default"}
```
```json
{"title":"Bozza di progetto","slug":"bozza-progetto","status":"draft"}
```

## page.remove

Delete a page as a person does: its record and its tree, in one step that undo puts back. Use it rather than page.delete and page.drop. Refused with `page.has_children` (pages sit under it: move or delete them first), `page.home` (the home page), `page.inMenu` (a menu links it: menuItem.remove first; detail.menus), `page.linked` (something links to it; detail.links), `page.notFoundPage` (the page shown at a missing address: settings.setNotFound first) and `unknown_page`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"cdf66aa4-4320-4c8d-a7ed-8c10c0b64989"}
```

## page.setHead

Set or clear fields of a page's head, what search engines, link previews and the browser tab read. Its fields: title, meta title, description, social image, canonical address, noindex and structured-data subject. A field given is set, null clears it (the title cannot be cleared), a field left out is kept. A field's value in another language is a translation (translation.set, pointer `/head/<field>`). Refused with `head.image` (no such image in the media library, or an SVG or a video), `head.subject` (a subject reading fields the page's collection lacks, or on a page that is no dynamic page) and `unknown_page` (the page has no tree).

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "title", "seo", "share", "sharing".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page of the site: its id, as site_context lists the pages. |
| `head` | object | yes |  |
| `head` › `title` | string (max 200) |  | The page title the title template wraps for the browser tab and search results; it cannot be cleared. |
| `head` › `metaTitle` | string (min 1, max 200) \| null |  | The whole `<title>`, used as it is instead of the templated title; null clears it. |
| `head` › `description` | string (min 1, max 1000) \| null |  | What search results and link previews say under the title; null: the site's default. |
| `head` › `noIndex` | true \| null |  | True keeps the page out of search engines; null lets them in again. |
| `head` › `ogImage` | uuid \| null |  | The picture a link preview shows: a media id of a raster image (no SVG); null: the site's default. |
| `head` › `canonical` | string (max 2000) \| null |  | The address search engines should count the page under: an absolute http(s) URL; null clears it. |
| `head` › `subject` | { type: "SoftwareApplication", category?: string, operatingSystem?: string (min 1, max 80), offer?: { price: string, currency: string } } \| { type: "Product", offer?: { price: string, currency: string } } \| { type: "Article" \| "BlogPosting" \| "TechArticle", from?: { headline?: string (max 60), datePublished?: string (m… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) |  | What the page presents as structured data (schema.org): an Article, BlogPosting or TechArticle (on a dynamic page, the item fields it reads), a Product or a SoftwareApplication; written when the page has a canonical URL. Null clears it. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"pageId":"87c82653-80cd-4b17-ae54-aca941cbf8a2","head":{"metaTitle":"Archiplan — Studio di architettura a Roma","description":"Restauro, residenziale, commerciale e culturale: spazi che bilanciano luce, materia e proporzione.","ogImage":"86ec6080-05c6-423e-a6b3-d921c8449495"}}
```
```json
{"pageId":"51c8bffb-cbdb-4746-afad-319dbc96382d","head":{"canonical":"https://www.archiplan.it/lavori/via-giulia","subject":{"type":"Article"},"noIndex":null}}
```
